page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.10xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at 3.1 GHz. It features 40 dedicated physical cores with 1 thread per core, providing a total of 40 vCPUs. The instance is equipped with 192.0 GB of RAM, yielding 4.8 GB of memory per core. It utilizes the KVM hypervisor and does not include local storage or GPU hardware. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 12 Gbps.

Benchmark results place this instance in the average performance tier across multiple tests. It achieves a stress-ng single-core CPU score of 1438.99 and a multi-core score of 38378.07. Memory performance includes a read-only small block cached bandwidth of 2133.36 GB/sec, which drops to 108.89 GB/sec for large block uncached reads, and a write bandwidth of 48.09 GB/sec. In application-specific benchmarks, the server processes 34.78 million Redis SET operations per second and delivers a static web serving throughput of 25.35 GB/sec. For language model tasks, it processes 1841.39 prompt tokens per second on a small 135M model, dropping to 56.94 tokens per second on a medium 7B model.

The lack of local storage requires reliance on network-attached storage, which may impact I/O-heavy workloads. However, the dedicated CPU allocation with one thread per physical core ensures consistent compute performance without hyperthreading interference. This hardware profile is qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads requiring high-frequency single-threaded execution and predictable CPU performance. It is suited for database operations, software compilation, web serving, and moderate-scale machine learning inference.
